prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn parity_stable_partition(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Return all even values in their original order followed by all odd values in their original order, joined by commas. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: 3,2,-1,4,0 returns 2,4,0,3,-1.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn parity_stable_partition(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let mut o:Vec<_>=a.iter().filter(|x|**x%2==0).copied().collect();o.extend(a.iter().filter(|x|**x%2!=0));Some(join(&o))}
